card.name: Final letter of mcL and mcg
card.fires_on: The last letter of the unit "mcL" or "mcg" after "mc", mostly in blood count thresholds such as neutrophil counts per mcL. It also fires on the "g" in microgram doses.

modes.label: mcL in cell counts
modes.description: The "L" ending "mc" in blood cell count limits like ANC or neutrophils.

modes.label: mcg in doses
modes.description: The "g" ending "mc" in microgram doses or concentrations.

card.plain: It marks the end of the unit mcL or mcg when it is written after a number.
